t.zh: 波形发生器提供了可比较的刻度，现在让它与观测发生联系。直接看一行平均亮度会漏掉正负抵消的条纹；用匹配波形检验某个频率是否有贡献。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The wave generator provides a basis. Connect it to observations: averaging brightness misses zero-mean stripes. Test a frequency through comparison with its matching wave. <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: P(k,p) = (1/N) Σ x[n] cos(2π(kn/N + p)) 求和遍历整行 N 个样本。乘积测量信号与参考波是否同向，平均值避免行长直接放大响应。对匹配的孤立正弦波 x[n]=A cos(2πkn/N+φ)，在 0
after.en: P(k,p) = (1/N) Σ x[n] cos(2π(kn/N + p)) The sum uses all N samples. Products measure alignment with the reference, and the mean avoids scaling response with row length. For an isolated matching sinusoid x[n]=A cos(2πkn/N+φ), matching integer frequencies 0

brief.zh: 让图像读数与指定频率、相位的波形逐格比较，输出每行的平均乘积。不同频率会在整行中互相抵消。
brief.en: Compare readings with a specified basis frequency/phase through their mean product per row. Different frequencies cancel over the row.

t.zh: 波形使用每行的归一化位置 x/N；行内位置元件直接给出这张刻度表。投影采用平均乘积而不是总和，使同一周期的读数数量改变时，系数不随行长成倍放大。逐行汇总在这里新增“平均”。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The wave uses normalised positions x/N, supplied by the row-position component. Projection uses mean products rather than sums so changing the number of samples does not multiply coefficient scale. Row reduction now introduces mean. <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 只平均基波没有使用观测；相同探针将对所有图像给出同一结果。
naiveWhy.en: Averaging the basis alone ignores the observation, producing the same result for different signals.

hint.zh: 观察同频与异频信号的逐格乘积。平均自动完成，但必须把观测纳入比较。
hint.en: Inspect products for matching and differing frequencies. Mean is automatic, but the observation must participate.

desc.zh: 输出各行观测与指定波形的平均乘积，保留正负。
desc.en: Return each row’s signed mean product with the specified basis wave.
